LAW AND MOTION 301, NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: PLAINTIFF REBECCA WALLACE'S AMENDED MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED. NEITHER PLAINTIFF'S NOTICE OR SEPERATE STATEMENT PROPERLY SPECIFIES THE CAUSE OF ACTION OR ISSUE UPON WHICH SEEKS SUMMARY ADJUDICATION EVEN IF THE MOTION WERE CONSTRUED AS PROPERLY SEEKING SUMMARY ADJUDICATION ON CAUSE OF ACTION 1, IT WOULD NOT COMPLETELY DISPOSE OF THAT CAUSE OF ACTION BECAUSE IT DOES NOT SPECIFY A DAMAGE AMOUNT. IN ANY EVENT THE EARLIER RULING DID NOT NECESSARILY DETERMINE THE ELEMENTS OF THIS CLAIM BUT ONLY THAT THERE WAS HARASSMENT AND A PHYSICAL INTERACTION. OPPOSING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
